title: Security review pass: LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC beacon/GPS time-sync path
description: Follow-up from cbyn (verify-and-close): the configurable time-sync path (beacon SFN with GPS stratum-0 priority, RTC fallback) indexed under CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC has not had a security pass. Scope: lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_rx.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c, link.h usage sites. Kconfig help claims SECURITY: signed beacons only - verify enforcement.
